text: FIR No. 402/2026: On 30-Aug-2026 between 10:00 and 12:00 hrs, commercial burglary reported at MG Road showroom. Informant stated suspects were operating coordinated mobile communications. Subsequent armed robbery reported at Brigade Road on 31-Aug-2026 between 02:00 and 04:00 hrs. Preliminary investigation links financial laundering courier movements to the syndicate.
